# Venice, Building by Building

A 3D atlas of Venice's historic centre: 11,137 buildings coloured by construction epoch, assembled through time.

- Pipeline: Python (geopandas, shapely) → GeoJSON/GeoParquet → viewer binary tiles
- Viewer: Three.js r186 (SydMap engine), vanilla JS
- Live: https://venice.osovsky.com
- Docs: docs/ (engine audit, VPRG classification, data inventories, viewer contract)
- Licence: MIT (pipeline), ODbL (OSM), CC BY 4.0 (VPRG), CC0 (Wikidata)
